title: Broken value list reference
description:
Layout-quality rule — a layout object references a value list that no longer exists in its file. Resolution runs over the value-list ID, not the name, so renamed lists are not reported.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Broken Value List <Missing>" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A control bound to a deleted value list offers no choices at runtime — the pop-up stays empty and data entry silently fails.
rule.remediation: Bind the object to an existing value list, or recreate the missing one.
